description: Source code for ARC4 encryption driver in Linux kernel, implementing hardware-accelerated ARC4 cipher and its integration with Linux crypto API.

methods.name: _deu_arc4
methods.description: Main interface to ARC4 hardware for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: arc4_set_key
methods.description: Sets the ARC4 encryption key in hardware.

methods.name: arc4_set_key_skcipher
methods.description: Sets the ARC4 key for skcipher API.

methods.name: _deu_arc4_ecb
methods.description: Configures ARC4 hardware for ECB mode encryption/decryption.

methods.name: arc4_crypt
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts a block of data using ARC4.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_arc4
methods.description: Initializes and registers ARC4 driver with Linux crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_arc4
methods.description: Unregisters ARC4 driver from Linux crypto API.
